about: Side-market count models (corners, cards) for the prediction ledger - LEARNING ONLY, never tips or stakes. src/side_models/. A tracked league is served for a family only when its history is VERIFIED by two sources (see `verification`); every other tracked league is listed in the artifact with its reason and gets no rows. Statistics only - no prices are read or written.

corners.count: API-Football /fixtures/statistics 'Corner Kicks' per team (90 minutes), verified per fixture against football-data HC/AC where football-data has them, else single-source sanity

cards.count: API-Football /fixtures/statistics 'Yellow Cards' + 'Red Cards' per team (a card count, not booking points; a second-yellow dismissal is counted the provider's way - owner cards rule 2026-11-18 closes G9), verified per fixture against football-data HY/AY/HR/AR where football-data has them, else single-source sanity (src/side_models/data.py)

verification.rule: per fixture: the two sources agree (src/side_models/data.py verify); per league x family: two-source overlap >= min_overlap_pct of the API-Football fixtures in the football-data window AND agreement >= min_agree_pct on that overlap
verification.cards_rule: owner 2026-11-18 (closes audit G9): reds exact; yellows exact on a team without a red; on a team with a red, API-Football yellows - football-data yellows in [0, 2 x reds]

fixture_source: output/collect/upcoming_fixtures.parquet (API-Football fixture ids and team ids; refreshed by daily_injuries_lineups.yml)

single_source.rule: owner 2026-11-18: a tracked league football-data publishes no corners/cards for uses API-Football /fixtures/statistics as its single certified source. A fixture is used only when its counts pass the sanity rules (src/side_models/data.py SANITY: every count present, none negative or impossible, not all zero); nothing is filled. The league is covered when API-Football holds stats for >= min_stats_pct of its finished fixtures since window_from and >= min_sane_pct of those pass. Rows carry basis 'single_source' (ledger payload_version).
